say:1:1064205001:0.text: As Ain's figure fades from the dream, the outline of a beautiful unicorn slowly takes shape beside Aurora.
say:1:1064205001:0.source_cn: 梦境之中，埃因的身影散去后，一个梦幻而俊美的独角兽轮廓...

say:3:1064205002:0.text: Hmm... That dreadful mess is finally over.
say:3:1064205002:0.source_cn: 哼……这场混乱的噩梦总算了结了。

say:4:1064205003:0.text: I'll be frank, Aurora. I'm honestly more concerned about his mind—imagine not even knowing what your wish is. Good grief.
say:4:1064205003:0.source_cn: 我得说句实话，奥萝菈。比起他的双腿，我更为他的头脑担心...

say:6:1064205004:0.text: Perhaps it's because once you allow yourself to hope, you also risk disappointment... and if that hope is crushed, an even deeper despair may swallow you whole.
say:6:1064205004:0.source_cn: 也许是因为，他不敢幻想双腿还能康复，唯恐希望落空，被更...

say:7:1064205005:1.text: You know, Sonny... I understand that feeling better than you might think.
say:7:1064205005:1.source_cn: 你知道吗？桑尼，其实，我很能理解那种心情……

say:8:1064205006:1.text: Dear Aurora, your one and only weakness is your kindness.
say:8:1064205006:1.source_cn: 亲爱的奥萝菈，你唯一的缺点就是太过善良了。

say:9:1064205007:1.text: If you ask me, you should've just let me into his dream. I'd have ended the war, wiped out the Hypofiends like a glorious hero, and that would've been the end of his nightmares.
say:9:1064205007:1.source_cn: 要我说，直接让我进入他的梦境，用潇洒的身姿扫除战火啊、...

say:10:1064205008:1.text: And with all that time saved, you could have had a lovely rest for once!
say:10:1064205008:1.source_cn: 节省下来的时间，让你多休息一会儿，美美地睡上一觉，那该...

say:11:1064205009:1.text: Perhaps... I was so careful because I saw my old self in him.
say:11:1064205009:1.source_cn: 或许……是因为我在埃因身上看到了自己，所以才格外细致地...

say:12:1064205010:1.text: Wh-What? What exactly does he have in common with you other than having a reasonably good heart?
say:12:1064205010:1.source_cn: 什——什么？！他除了心地还不错之外，有哪点能和你相较？...

say:13:1064205011:1.text: I was once like him too... bedridden for life because of my legs.
say:13:1064205011:1.source_cn: 但是，我也曾经和他一样……因为腿疾，被永远地困在床榻上。

say:14:1064205012:1.text: That was before Dura blessed me... before she ascended me to one of her Celestials.
say:14:1064205012:1.source_cn: 那时的我，还没有受到艾雅女神的眷顾，被擢升为半神……

say:15:1064205013:0.text: It's not a time I treasure, but rather a nightmare so deep and hopeless that I couldn't imagine ever waking from it.
say:15:1064205013:0.source_cn: 那不是什么值得珍藏的回忆……它宛如一场幽深绝望的噩梦，...

say:16:1064205014:0.text: Sleep was the happiest thing I knew, since dreams were the only yet brief escape from the pain.
say:16:1064205014:0.source_cn: 对那时的我来说，睡觉就是最幸福的事……因为在梦里，我可...

say:17:1064205015:0.text: There were times when I prayed to Dura to let me sleep forever—
say:17:1064205015:0.source_cn: 我常常向艾雅女神祈祷，祈祷自己能不再醒来。

say:18:1064205016:1.text: So, my family would be spared their worry... and I would be spared my pain.
say:18:1064205016:1.source_cn: 那样的话，我的家人不必再担忧。而我……也不必再忍受痛苦。

say:19:1064205017:1.text: I'm sorry, Aurora. I didn't mean to upset you.
say:19:1064205017:1.source_cn: 噢……抱歉，奥萝菈，我没有想惹你伤心……

say:20:1064205018:1.text: No worries... You see, I'm no longer trapped by illness now.
say:20:1064205018:1.source_cn: 没关系……你看，现在，我已经不会再被病魔所困了。

say:21:1064205019:1.text: It's precisely because of my time bedridden in despair that I understand Ain's pain more deeply.
say:21:1064205019:1.source_cn: 不过，正是因为经历过卧病在床的绝望，我才格外理解埃因心...

say:22:1064205020:1.text: And besides... his nightmare comes from that war.
say:22:1064205020:1.source_cn: 何况……他的梦魇，来源于那场战争……

say:23:1064205021:1.text: The damage it inflicted was not on his flesh, but on his spirit.
say:23:1064205021:1.source_cn: 战争给他带来的创伤，不在肉体……而在心灵。

say:24:1064205022:1.text: If we do nothing more than dispel the nightmare, without healing his wounds, then it may return in a few years... or even in a few months.
say:24:1064205022:1.source_cn: 如果我们不能治愈他内心的创伤，即便清除了噩梦，也许几年...

say:25:1064205023:1.text: Well... at least not every mortal's dream is quite this much trouble.
say:25:1064205023:1.source_cn: 唉！幸好不是每个凡人的梦境都这么麻烦。

say:26:1064205024:1.text: I much prefer the kind with beasts and ghosts. One good kick and a sharp warning, and they run off with their tails between their legs.
say:26:1064205024:1.source_cn: 我还是更喜欢那些只有野兽、幽灵出没的噩梦。稍微踹它们一...

say:27:1064205025:1.text: "Bring solace to those lost in despair. Shape sweet dreams for them... and most importantly, let the dreams give them the strength to face despair when morning comes."
say:27:1064205025:1.source_cn: “安抚世间绝望之人，为他们创造美丽的梦境……最重要的是...

say:28:1064205026:1.text: This is the duty Dura placed in my hands...
say:28:1064205026:1.source_cn: 这是艾雅女神留给我的嘱托……

say:29:1064205027:1.text: We'll have to work hard, Sonny, if we're to help everyone become as carefree as you.
say:29:1064205027:1.source_cn: 为了把大家都变得和你一样无忧无虑，我们得加油了，桑尼。

say:30:1064205028:1.text: Carefree? Me? I have far too much on my mind!
say:30:1064205028:1.source_cn: 无忧无虑？哪里无忧无虑？我要操心的事可太多了！

say:31:1064205029:1.text: Running off my feet clearing nightmares is one thing, but keeping watch so that the spiteful butterfly, Tasi doesn't sneak into your dreams and stir up trouble is another! Her talent for disaster is... Just mentioning her gives me a headache...
say:31:1064205029:1.source_cn: 除了清除凡人的噩梦，还要防着塔西那个坏心眼的小蝴蝶跑到...

say:32:1064205030:1.source_cn: 好了，好了……不要激动，桑尼。

say:33:1064205031:1.text: This is no time to rest. There are still so many people trapped in despair, waiting for the comfort that dreams can bring...
say:33:1064205031:1.source_cn: 现在还不是休息的时候。有很多人仍深陷绝望之中，等待着梦...

say:34:1064205032:1.text: Let's be on our way... to the next dream.
say:34:1064205032:1.source_cn: 我们现在就出发吧……去下一场梦境。

say:35:1064205033:1.text: May the sufferings of war soon fade from Esperia... and from mortal dreams alike.
say:35:1064205033:1.source_cn: 但愿，战争带来的创伤，能早日从伊索米亚……也从凡人的梦...

say:36:1064205034:1.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah, I'm coming. Whatever you say, dear Aurora.
say:36:1064205034:1.source_cn: 好好好……都听你的，亲爱的奥萝菈。

say:37:1064205035:1.text: With you standing guard over their dreams, those mortals truly are blessed.
say:37:1064205035:1.source_cn: 有你庇护他们的梦境，连我都替这些凡人感到荣幸呢。
